Daily account balances, APR categories and grace periods matter; site estimate explicitly excludes issuer-specific compounding and allocation.
360/365 daily divisors depend on issuer; daily compounding is not implemented by the simple-interest approximation.
Staged construction advances; a permanent loan is a separate stage. Source does not establish universal date/accrual rules.
